messages:
elaine: Quick sync: I'm proposing an 'ingress_hint' field in rollout metadata. Purpose: weak preference for which ingress/gateway subgroup should serve a pinned model to improve KV cache locality and reduce p95 tail for hot tenants. Not a hard placement.

samir: Can you outline the concrete behavior we expect from resolvers? Need to avoid semantics drift.

elaine: Expected: resolver treats ingress_hint as a soft preference used only for tie-breaking when multiple candidates are capacity-compatible. We also add an optional 'transition_ms' to smooth migrations.

matt: Two immediate cautions: 1) validation surface (known id set) 2) don't let this bypass capacity checks and autoscaling. Also prefer integer priority over floats to simplify logging.

maria: Backcompat: older controllers must ignore unknown fields. Document ingress_hint as control-plane-only (clients/SDKs must not act on it). Also ops want a default ramp window for hint changes to avoid cache thrash.

jin: Example payload idea (text): {"pin":"chat-v3","ingress_hint":"ingress-us-e-2","ingress_priority":"6","transition_ms":"600000","expires_at":"2026-07-01T00:00:00Z","telemetry_opt_in":"ingress_hint"}

samir: Resolver pseudocode suggestion:
```
if not capacity_ok(candidate): continue
score = base_score(candidate)
if candidate.ingress_id == hint.id:
  score += hint.priority * 2
else if candidate.region == hint.region:
  score += hint.priority
// we never hard-route: capacity short-circuits always
```

matt: Validation rules: ingress ids ascii a-z0-9 and dashes, max 32 chars, prefix 'ingress-'. Control plane maintains registry. Writes with unknown ids should be rejected unless caller sets allow_unregistered_hint=true (experimental). Log an audit event on unregistered hints.

maria: Migration behavior: when ingress_hint changes we apply transition_ms as a soft window. During the window resolvers prefer both old+new ingress with decayed weights to avoid mass invalidation. Ops dashboard: ingress-locality-hit-rate, kv-cache-miss, p95-rlatency. Alert if cache-miss rate rises >20% after changes.

ops-bot: schema-checker: draft schema 'rollout-meta-v1.5-ingress-hint' pushed to staging. Failing consumers: 3 legacy resolvers.

elaine: Telemetry plan: start opt-in. Measure impact on p95 for tenants with stateful caches. Target: 3-8% p95 improvement for top 5% heavy-tenants. If we see wins, consider making hints available more broadly.

jin: Tests: add unit tests for (1) absent field (backcompat), (2) known hint with priority, (3) unknown hint with allow_unregistered_hint, (4) transition_ms respected and gradual weight decay. Add e2e load test to watch KV-miss behavior.

samir: I'll implement scoring change behind a runtime flag and add unit tests. Keep transitions non-blocking.

matt: I'll add schema change and strict validator. Default behavior: reject unknown ids. PR target Thu.

maria: I'll write the runbook for transition_ms and a throttle for bulk hint updates (rate limit changes per tenant to avoid ripple).

ops-bot: created issue INFRA-2407 to track schema PR, validation, tests, and dashboards.

elaine: One more: recordability. Add lightweight telemetry field 'ingress_hint_opt_in' to the metadata so rollouts can opt in. We should never auto-enrich pins with hints.

matt: Agreed. No auto-inference for now. Keep it explicit and auditable.

elaine: Action list: matt -> schema + validator; samir -> resolver tie-breaker + tests; maria -> migration ramp/runbook + dashboards; jin -> tests + e2e; ops-bot -> monitor CI. Follow-up in ~48h once PRs land. :thumbsup:
